title: SearchAssistWeights
description: Manifest of the search-assist head's weights (ROUTER-BUILD-01a): a logistic head over the utterance embedding. Home refuses to score when the embed identity differs from what the Stack embed role reports. Inference is a dot product; no text is stored here.

preprocess.description: Name of the preprocess applied before embedding, matching Home's EMBED_PREPROCESS.

prefix.description: Text prefix added before embedding; empty string for raw.

coef.description: One row per class (one row for a binary head, as scikit-learn exports it), one column per feature.

thresholds.description: Per-tool score threshold, keyed by tool name.

label_spec_version.description: The turn-label schema version the head was trained against.

bench_record.description: Where the bench numbers for this head are recorded.
